title: CI, split и релиз-манифест: collaboration PHP, хаб, vue-collaboration, collaboration-hub-image.yml
summary: ci.yml (`PHP_SUPPORT` + collaboration, Node-джоба хаба, джоба vue-collaboration, consumer-isolation + collaboration), weekly-full.yml (те же матрицы), `git mv .github/workflows/hocuspocus-image.yml .github/workflows/collaboration-hub-image.yml` (image `ghcr.io/axiomasoft/vaulter-collaboration-hub`, тег `vaulter-collaboration-hub-v*`), monorepo-split.yml + collaboration, release-npm.yml + vue-collaboration, release/packages.json (php/npm/images), scripts/release/consumer-check.sh + collaboration и кейс в tests/Repo/ConsumerCheckTest.php.
why: D1, D6, architecture#packages: новый Composer-пакет, npm-пакет и образ хаба выпускаются отдельно; I14 требует изоляции каждого split-пакета. Hard risk: CI-джобы и split не запускаются в PLAN3 — ошибки видны только статическими проверками (WorkflowPolicyTest, test-release-tools, consumer-check --dry-run).

include: release/packages.json; scripts/release/{consumer-check.sh,verify-split-tags.sh}; tests/Repo/ConsumerCheckTest.php; scripts/ci/workflow-policy.py — если проверяет матрицы пакетов
exclude: Отложено в PLAN4: `scripts/release/consumer-check.sh collaboration` без --dry-run, сборка/публикация образа, запуск workflows

reads.why: границы P5, точные команды качества, размещение тестов, схема, ledger, прогрессия инвариантов
Fast-набор D41: что исполняется в пункте

rules: Матрица PHP_SUPPORT совпадает с composer.json пакетов (test_support_matrix_follows_composer).

validation.cmd: jq -e '([.php[] | select(.path == "packages/collaboration")] | length == 1) and ([.npm[] | select(.name == "@vaulter/vue-collaboration")] | length == 1) and ([.images[] | select(.path == "packages/collaboration/hub")] | length == 1)' release/packages.json

result.notes:
collaboration added to the CI/weekly-full PHP_SUPPORT matrices, a new vue-collaboration lane (ci.yml job + changes output + ci-gate need, weekly-full job + full-gate need, workflow-policy LANES/LANE_JOBS/plan_outputs), consumer-isolation and the split matrix; hocuspocus-image.yml git-mv'd to collaboration-hub-image.yml (image ghcr.io/axiomasoft/vaulter-collaboration-hub, tag vaulter-collaboration-hub-v*); release/packages.json gets the collaboration PHP package, @vaulter/vue-collaboration and the renamed image; consumer-check usage and ConsumerCheckTest (collaboration dataset entry + dev-sibling case); WorkflowPolicyTest and test-release-tools updated. Found by the dry run: tests/i17-scenarios.json reached ../documents/tests and ../vue-collaboration/tests, which the I14 check rightly rejects; those entries are now monorepo-root paths and I17ScenarioMapTest checks them only inside the monorepo.
Changed: .github/workflows/ci.yml, .github/workflows/collaboration-hub-image.yml, .github/workflows/hocuspocus-image.yml, .github/workflows/monorepo-split.yml, .github/workflows/release-npm.yml, .github/workflows/weekly-full.yml, package.json, packages/collaboration/hub/Dockerfile, packages/collaboration/hub/README.md, packages/collaboration/hub/docker-compose.yml, packages/collaboration/tests/Arch/I17ScenarioMapTest.php, packages/collaboration/tests/i17-scenarios.json, packages/vue-collaboration/package.json, release/packages.json, scripts/ci/workflow-policy.py, scripts/release/consumer-check.sh, scripts/test-release-tools.py, tests/Repo/ConsumerCheckTest.php, tests/Repo/WorkflowPolicyTest.py, tests/baseline/CHANGES.json, tests/baseline/CHANGES.md, tests/baseline/repo.count, tests/baseline/repo.list
deviations: V6 exits 1 in the executor sandbox: 18 of 19 ConsumerCheckTest tests pass (including the new collaboration cases); 'stages the root Pest harness next to core' fails because tar cannot copy the sandbox-masked packages/collaboration/hub/package-lock.json (Cannot mknod). core's consumer closure now includes collaboration, so its copy takes the hub dir.

I14 dry-run of collaboration failed on packages/collaboration/tests/i17-scenarios.json (P5.13) naming ../documents/tests/... and ../vue-collaboration/tests/...: a split archive has no sibling tests. Entries now use monorepo-root paths (packages/<name>/tests/...); I17ScenarioMapTest resolves them from the monorepo root and checks them only where release/packages.json exists.

Changed outside scope.write_set, each needed by the piece: package.json (root build/test now cover @vaulter/vue-collaboration, vue first, so release-npm builds a non-empty dist), packages/vue-collaboration/package.json (vaulter.api=1, required by check-versions.php for manifest npm entries), scripts/test-release-tools.py (built-zip list gains vaulter-collaboration), packages/collaboration/tests/{i17-scenarios.json,Arch/I17ScenarioMapTest.php}, packages/collaboration/hub/{Dockerfile,README.md,docker-compose.yml} (image/workflow name only; instance name default vaulter-hocuspocus kept), tests/baseline/{repo.list,repo.count,CHANGES.json,CHANGES.md} (baseline --write -p repo).
Baseline compare over core..load and repo exits 0; the vue and vue-collaboration suites were not compared because vitest discovery needs the npm registry (sandbox blocks it), as in P5.4-P5.13.
